purpose: Evidence-first comparison of alternatives to the Hedgehog and neuromodulation proposals.
status: Literature, selected code, and numerical artifact inspection. No model execution, training, fitting, new biological validation, or runtime benchmark.

review_method.interpretation: B1 and C1 are ready for bounded reproduction attempts; A1 is conditional for a quantitative intervention experiment. This classification does not establish a working or validated model.
shared_gates: Predeclare error criteria from measurement variability
review_method.environment_note: One search used an isolated temporary NumPy/SciPy/h5py environment for artifact inspection. No simulator or checkpoint was executed. Downloaded research payloads were kept outside the project.

candidates.name: Visual motion opponency
candidates.verdict: Keep as a bounded reproduction; first recommendation.
critic_findings: Intervention assay is ArcLight voltage imaging; mixed-motion assay includes electrophysiology. Preserve separate cohorts, signs, units, and normalization.
The feedback-block notebook defaults to condition=6 (LPi-to-VS removal); condition=3 is feedback block. Pass intervention explicitly.
Model conductance is arbitrary units with leak=1; experimental plotted nS needs verified conversion. Use fixed dimensionless ratios or independent calibration.
Conductance arrays have invalid tail samples outside the published analysis interval. Do not zero-fill or silently change windows.
Outgoing-column deletion models output block; losing the deleted pathway alone is weak evidence. Require spared responses and mixed-motion tests.
Animal grouping for 16 cells must be recovered before claiming independent-animal uncertainty.
candidates.novelty_boundary: Published architecture and parameters were developed with the target observations. Initial work is retrospective reproduction and model comparison.

candidates.name: Neural compass memory
candidates.verdict: Keep with calibration-only prediction protocol and observation-aware baselines.
critic_findings: Idealized recurrent ring, not a detailed MaleCNS circuit or autonomous navigation model.
Published gain fits pool all five trials per fly. Fit only declared calibration trials for new evaluation.
Plot_Bump_Examples aligns heading using neural phase inside each displayed 40-second window; this leaks target information if copied into prediction.
The exported aligned-heading construction remains unresolved; use measured angular velocity and one disclosed initial neural phase per test trial.
Plot helper has an apparent logical-indexing issue; code was inspected, not execution-tested.
Calcium data are smoothed over 11 frames at 10 Hz. Include an observation-aware null and longer stationary intervals.
All trials are in darkness. Light-off and optogenetic manipulations require separate matched evidence.
Compare scalar and leaky integrators, show all animals, and do not treat a retrospective split as a new biological replication.
unresolved_details: GCaMP reporter designation differs between Methods and reporting summary; resolve before quantitative reporter modeling.
Full fluorescence observation mapping is not independently calibrated.

candidates.name: Feeding motor-sequence disinhibition
candidates.verdict: Conditional: reproduce original outputs first; selective intervention prediction requires a repaired correspondence.
critic_findings: Biology selectively silences MN12V; ort conductance applies to all motor layers in inspected LIF_FD_exp.m.
Supplied model agrees directionally but not quantitatively with the selected delay. Another IN intervention differs even in residual mean ordering sign.
Figure 7 reuses earlier biological observations; it is not another independent cohort.
Imposed current pulse is not autonomous feeding rhythm or ingestion.
Unknown intervention strength must not be tuned against the outcome reserved for evaluation.
SC and FD implementations use different layer counts; compare calibration freedom fairly.
Excitatory expression references exclayer(1).V for all layers; needs equation-to-code check, not an established bug.
candidates.access_boundary: Public abstract/figure captions, supplementary tables/reporting information, workbooks and selected code inspected. Full main Methods were inaccessible. Paired intervention delay summaries were acquired; the underlying spike trains for that cohort were not secured.
candidates.compute_boundary: MATLAB toolbox/parallel-pool dependencies or a verified port needed; no execution benchmark.

candidates.name: Sweet-bitter response selectivity
candidates.verdict: Conditional existing-substrate alternative; neural response reproduction only.
critic_findings: Workbook says fed; figure caption says food-deprived.
Unilateral model list of 21 sweet and 21 bitter GRNs needs matching to bilateral genetic driver/illumination coverage.
Target is synaptic Syt::GCaMP7b, not measured firing rate.
Weak bitter-only responses may not identify the decisive input strength; coactivation cannot be treated as constrained prediction without addressing this.
No full feeding probability or hunger-specific claim.

candidates.name: JON subtype recruitment of aBN1
candidates.verdict: Keep as a published-results explainer; defer quantitative validation.
critic_findings: Inspected supplementary numerical tables include simulation outputs, not the needed per-fly aBN1 calcium traces.
Unequal excitation plus threshold is an alternative to inhibition-specific explanation.
Three-cell disinhibition rescue is biologically untested and was already proposed in 2024.
Both input populations can evoke grooming; weak aBN1 response is not no grooming.

candidates.name: Stationary-pattern motion illusion
candidates.verdict: Conditional; actual biological data access and readout provenance unresolved.
candidates.access_result: Manifest inspected; ordinary data requests returned 401/403 during this session, independently checked by critic.
critic_findings: T5 silencing enhances usual turning; T4 silencing reverses it.
Published compact model threshold was chosen for the illusion; downstream T4/T5 weighting uses observed baseline turning.
Keep neural signal separate from tethered-walking turning and subjective perception.
A frozen Flyvis ensemble is a possible later comparator, not a validated movement interface.

candidates.name: Reverse-phi voltage benchmark
candidates.verdict: Defer first implementation; data conversion and fit provenance need work.
critic_findings: Ready-made modelFigureCode.m selects row 345 by moving-bar error; cannot call this supplied example a flash-only prediction.
Paper distinguishes full flash-plus-motion fit from a reduced flash-only fit.
Biological archives are multi-GB and not parsed; MATLAB table values remain opaque to the inspected SciPy route.
Behavioral experiment is tethered flying, not walking-ball steering.

candidates.name: CxHP8 proprioceptive limit reflex
candidates.verdict: Defer predictive embodiment; a measured replay and anatomical audit are possible after data access.
candidates.access_result: Dryad manifest and metadata inspected; small-file download also returned 403.
critic_findings: Author code is analysis and signed pathway scoring, not a runnable neural-muscle-body dynamics model.
Driver labels six of eight front-leg CxHP8 neurons, while anatomical analysis includes all eight.
Female anatomy and male functional experiments; chronic silencing is not an acute runtime lesion.
flyid includes trial number; do not count strings as independent animals.
8.26-Hz calcium interpolated to 300 Hz is not 300-Hz physiological resolution.

candidates.name: Odor-on surge and odor-off search
candidates.verdict: Conditional moving-agent reserve; behavioral rather than neural model.
candidates.access_result: Public 6.94-GB behavior ZIP and separate 2.53-GB plume manifest inspected; numerical trials not parsed. Small README request returned 403.
critic_findings: Model equations directly encode speed/turning effects; qualitative animation is not an independent prediction.
Paper's plume-walk stimulus was excluded from ON/OFF fitting; this is a useful published reproduction target.
Most experiments use blind norpA36 flies; sighted controls and different plume regimes differ.
Plume movies and behavior were recorded in separate tunnels; compare distributions, not identical individual paths.
Wrapper calls an absent customized function; core model is present.

optional_model_audit.boundary: Trained early visual model, not a drop-in LPi/VS circuit. Packaged responses_norm.h5 contains simulated normalization data, not biological recordings. Do not choose a model using the evaluation response.
